author: The National
title: Iran war latest: Qatar PM to visit Tehran to push for de-escalation
text:
- Strait of Hormuz will reopen only if US accepts Tehran's conditions, warns IRGC
- US not expected to launch new strikes against Iran 'for the time being'
- US ambassador to Lebanon says talks with Hezbollah ‘possible’ but only if group is serious
- Trump's 'Economic D-Day' against Iran only fuels tensions, says China
- Lebanon’s President Aoun says negotiations with Israel preferable to war
- Omani foreign minister says talks on Hormuz in Tehran were 'constructive'
Updated: August 27, 2026, 3:57 AM
